about: Each category as one bar of 100%, split into the declared series' shares. The bars compare composition, and the caption states the totals.

mix.about: Customers per plan in each region as shares. The value axis reads in percent, and the tooltip writes each plan's own count.
mix.caption: Scale plans are 13% of the Americas' 1,300 customers, 10% of APAC's 300 and 9% of EMEA's 800.
mix.label: Customers per plan per region
mix.title: Plan mix

narrow.about: The plan mix in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone. The three bars keep their shares, and the region names fit below them.
narrow.title: Narrow room

region.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at the Americas when the chart first renders. The bar shows shares, and the tooltip writes each plan's own count.
region.caption: The Americas had 610 Starter, 520 Growth and 170 Scale customers.
region.title: Tooltip

replay.about: animate grows each segment from its base when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the bars at once.
replay.title: Animation

title: Percent stacked bar

unsold.about: A chart without rows renders the empty state in the plot's place, and no legend.
unsold.caption: Customers per plan per region.
unsold.empty: No customers in any region yet.
unsold.title: Empty
